content:
ben_arch: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we never landed on a single canonical 'version_fence' semantics for rollouts. Need concrete client/server behaviour and telemetry fields.

anna_devex: My take: soft = advisory (clients may ignore), hard = enforcement (server rejects mismatching requests). We should define an explicit error code for hard rejects.

miguel_sre: +1 for an explicit error. Also we need telemetry for diagnosing loops: fields like 'fence_evaluated' and 'fence_blocked' with request_id linkage.

ruby_pm: Product perspective: Dedicated customers expect predictable behavior. 'soft' could be surprising. Can we default enforcement based on deployment type (Dedicated -> hard, Hosted -> soft)? @ben_arch

ben_arch: Proposal: rollout metadata add fields: fence_type: ["none"|"soft"|"hard"], fence_ttl_secs, fence_enforcement: ["client"|"server"], fence_error_code. Telemetry dims: fence_evaluated, fence_blocked, fallback_model. Also include why (reason).

elaine_data: We must avoid cardinality explosion. Keep telemetry as counters + sampled traces. Suggest pin_decision enum: ["allowed","rejected","overridden"] and keep sampled trace (1/1000) of decision path with request_id.

miguel_sre: Metrics proposals: counter 'fence_rejection_total' (labels: model, tenant, fence_type), gauge 'fence_active' (per-model) and histogram 'fence_eval_duration_seconds'. Export via Prom.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: rollout-metadata-v2 -> staging @ 3990012350 :rocket:

ben_arch: Nice. Open question: when a hard fence expires (fence_ttl_secs) should server auto-failback to previous stable model or allow wildcard? My preference: auto-failback to last known stable pinned variant to avoid silent degradation.

ken_ops: Auto-failback is safer. Telemetry should record 'fence_expiry_action' and 'fence_expiry_reason'. Also add 'manual_override' boolean in metadata for ops takeovers.

anna_devex: SDK change: expose a PinViolationError with helpers to read 'recommended_fallback'. We'll ship migration helpers to surface deprecation notices.

ruby_pm: Timeline: telemetry + schema in next sprint; SDK changes following sprint. Docs + enterprise brief in the same cycle.

ben_arch: I'll draft a short RFC addendum with exact schema and example payloads. Quick nits?

elaine_data: Example payload suggestion: {"fence_type":"hard","fence_ttl_secs":3600,"fence_enforcement":"server","fence_error_code":"PIN_MISMATCH","recommended_fallback":"model-v1.2.3"}

miguel_sre: +1. Also consider adding a 'circuit_breaker' object (simple flags) to stop cascading rejections during incidents.

ben_arch: Noted — will include circuit_breaker boolean + backoff window. I'll ping infra and docs on Monday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
